verdict.rationale: Ligature support is independently corroborated: users call it the best ligature support they've seen with FiraCode, and it is a reason to prefer kitty over iTerm's Metal renderer. A first-party "Changing kitty fonts" doc and the kitty.conf reference exist, but the pack shows only their titles, not their contents. One user reports no bitmap font support. missing for 10: documented fallback-font/symbol-map configuration, evidence of fine-grained font tuning (size, line height, OpenType features, rendering options), first-party ligature documentation details.
